body.name: zeta
body.def: \(\zeta=(R,F,K,\mathcal J,\Sigma,\mathcal F,\mathcal L,\mathcal R,D_{\mathrm{den}},h)\), where \(R\) and \(F\) are disjoint random and fixed vertex masks, \(K=(K_{s,D})\) is a finite array of context-labelled rational kernel circuits indexed by \(s\in H\) and current districts \(D\), \(\mathcal J\) is the inherited finite polynomial constraint list from \(\mathcal I_H\), \(\Sigma,\mathcal F,\mathcal L,\mathcal R\) are the selector, fixing, elimination, and residual token lists, \(D_{\mathrm{den}}\) is the denominator registry, and \(h\) is the target-only-hole mask.
